predecessors.name: Kingdom of Spain
predecessors.text: the east of Spain's Cuba, held by Cliopatria's Spain row until 1894

successors.name: United States of America
successors.text: the island under the US military government from 1 January 1899

capitals.name: Camagüey (province; Jimaguayú and La Yaya assemblies)

ledger.x: 24 February 1895: the Cuban insurrection begins in the east.
June 1895: the insurrection spreads to Camagüey.
16 September 1895: the Republic in Arms gets a government.
22 January 1896: the invasion reaches the west.
10 December 1898: Spain gives up the island.
4 April 1899: the Republic in Arms ends.

wars.name: Cuban War of Independence
wars.outcome: The insurrection of 24 February 1895 ended with the United States' intervention in 1898: a protocol of peace on 12 August and the Treaty of Paris on 10 December 1898, followed by the US military government of 1 January 1899.

certainty.note: The rebel zone is where the insurrection operated, not held ground ('lacked control over stable territory'); no line is dated on the pages.
